# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-289#name-a-test-job-past-its-deadline

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-289#name-a-test-job-past-its-deadline (`.planning/seeds/SEED-289-named-test-results-locally-and-in-ci.md#name-a-test-job-past-its-deadline`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/563-end-test-jobs-at-their-deadline/PLAN.md`, revision `5a9b299ad6fe49c66e52d127268107889a86a3ab`. Isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-289-scratch` (clean pre-probe state; execution checkout unused for edits).
- **Promise.** Key example 1 / slice 1: a TERM-resistant owned process group is ended with bounded cleanup before queued work continues; a named TIMEOUT failure is recorded. Story scope: “A check ignoring TERM must not leave the deadline path waiting indefinitely.”
- **Fault.** In `scripts/owned-process-group.bash` (`owned_process_group_terminate`), removed the final `owned_process_group_signal KILL …` escalation after the TERM + grace wait, leaving only TERM. Fixture and assertions stayed intact; only production cleanup changed.
- **Fixture.** `tests/support/test-runner-deadline-continuation.test.mjs` case “a TERM-resistant owned group dies before queued work continues and the run fails”, via `bashHangCheck({ ignoreTerm: true, childIgnoresTerm: true })` and MakeMe/`deadlineRepository` + copied runner (`suiteRunnerLayer` / `copy_runner`).
- **Intended assertion.** The `until("first job group ended before successor entry", …)` wait at `test-runner-deadline-continuation.test.mjs:68` (assert in `local-test-suite-fixtures.mjs:31`), which requires the TERM-resistant parent and child dead before `second-ready`. Follow-on `assert.ok(!processRunning(parentPid) && !processRunning(childPid), …)` was not reached because this wait failed first on the same condition.
- **Runs.** Focused command: `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH bash scripts/test.sh tests/support/test-runner-deadline-continuation.test.mjs`.
  - Baseline (pre-fault): silent pass, `time -p` real **4.19 s**.
  - Fault: `not ok` on the TERM-resistant case with `AssertionError: Timed out: first job group ended before successor entry` (stack through `until` → continuation test line 68). Real **61.96 s**. Reach: expiry path ran far enough for the group-death-before-successor observation to fail; wrong behavior is the surviving TERM-resistant members without KILL.
  - Restored: file restored to pre-probe bytes; `git status` and HEAD matched the recorded clean pre-probe state; same focused command silent pass, real **4.23 s**, exit 0.
- **Finding.** **Caught.** Dropping KILL escalation breaks the important TERM-resistant cleanup promise, and the existing continuation proof fails on the intended group-death-before-successor path.

## Costs

- **Test runtime.** Measured with `/usr/bin/time -p` real on the focused command: baseline 4.19 s; fault 61.96 s; restored 4.23 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported human-effort measure was recorded for this invocation.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 204693 ms (measured), from 1794274245000 to 1794274449693 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
